programmes.d: An officer on Michigan's east side meets a driver on the road without a license and an officer on the state's west side patrols during a waterfowl hunt on a state game area.
Conservation Officers on patrols during fall fishing season as well as spring turkey season encounter suspects that have set fires in conditions where they shouldn't have.

Michigan Conservation Officers employ numerous tactics to enforce the state laws. Some of them include using aerial patrols to look out for illegal activitity as well as keeping an eye out for blinds on state land that have been in place too long.
Conservation Officers fish in plain clothes to see if anglers are snagging fish.
Part 2 of a night time patrol to stop anglers from keeping fish that are foul-hooked.
Conservation Officers serve warrants to a suspect believed to have taken 18 deer without licenses
Roger, his new girlfriend Shelly and her two young daughters are on a daytrip in the Arizona desert.
Six men are competing in a yacht race from Texas to the Gulf of Mexico, when their yacht capsizes.
50-year-old mountaineer Lincoln Hall attempted to climb Everest in 1984 but didn't reach the summit.
In 2003, David Hunt and his daughter Leia, set off on a snowmobiling adventure in the Quebec backcountry.
Two students are on a 3-day hike, but when their path is blocked by ice, the girls take a detour.

Kidd and Harry are sent into a dangerous free fall by a freak ATV accident; Jake goes on ranch patrol to protect newborn calves; Nancy gives Tom the surprise of a lifetime; Josh attempts to wrangle a feral horse.

Josh goes panning for gold in a quest to unearth the West's greatest treasure; Eustace fights to save his land, but must say goodbye to an old friend; Jason returns to the forge, putting his injured hand to the test.

As the spring melt sweeps the mountains, Jake sets his sights on bagging a black bear for the larder; Eustace and Raleigh race against time and weather to plant crops; Mike sets out to harvest a bounty from the Gulf of Alaska.

Mike flies into the Kodiak backcountry in search of rich bear hunting grounds; Jason rushes to complete a barn before his new herd of goats arrive; Kidd and Harry hunt down the bear that attacked their cattle.
Kidd and Harry go toe to toe with a one-ton bull; Eustace and Raleigh dig deep for Turtle Island's food stores; Mike braves the Kodiak interior on a bear scouting mission.

After a successful crossing of the Bering Strait the men have been taken into custody at gunpoint by the Russian Military. Word of the teams detainment goes viral as television networks all over the world report on the incident.
The expedition has been forced to cross back across the Bering Strait to the United States and Steven tries to convince the men to re-route and head through the Northwest Passage.

The men free themselves from the lagoon but Andrews attitude begins to effect the team. North bound the men push above the Arctic Circle and are forced to overnight in Kotzebue. Steven puts Andrew on notice.
